title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD importer matrix and downstream claim boundary
mode: primary-source web research and plan readiness refinement
scope: Refresh exact FreeCAD DXF importer entity sets and ACIS disposition
Separate FreeCAD DWG conversion from intermediate-DXF importer behavior
Reconfirm LibreCAD_3 DWG product boundary and independent ACIS evidence limits
Update the parity and 3D-support plans without adding test or qualification gates

method.limitations: This is a documentation/source-page review, not runtime qualification. FreeCAD's published importer feature matrix is a route declaration; converter/importer selection, exact build, output, and object dispositions still require a pinned native run for any compatibility claim. The LibreDWG issue is a version-specific report, not a reproduced current result.

sources.observed: The documented DXF backends are distinct: built-in C++ and legacy Python. The published class matrix lists 3DFACE for legacy Python but not for C++; both are documented not to read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. The DWG workflow converts through an external converter to DXF and then uses the selected importer. Exported edge linework/flattened views are projection behavior, not 3D import or solid-roundtrip evidence.
sources.limits: The page does not prove the behavior of a particular installed binary or the exact optional legacy add-on revision. It must not replace native Linux/Windows qualification for a claimed route.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2024; maintainer response and closure as not planned reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The maintainer states that ACIS solids embedded in DXF are opaque proprietary blobs that FreeCAD cannot read and closes the issue as not planned; the proposed workaround is conversion to an open exchange format by a proprietary application.
sources.limits: This is a maintained project disposition, not a format specification or evidence about a separately selected third-party importer/kernel.

sources.observed: The README says WITH_DWG_IMPORT is OFF by default and labels the route experimental. The DWG policy ledger is read-direction only, with no promoted claim and no DWG-write claim.
sources.limits: Product policy and documentation do not substitute for a consumer build/compatibility run and do not establish an independent parser or geometry kernel.

sources.observed: The browse-acis command documents viewing/exporting raw SAT/SAB carrier data.
sources.limits: Raw carrier inspection does not establish complete ACIS parsing, B-rep validity, topology, analytic geometry, or DWG AcDs association.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02 against LibreDWG 0.14.8593 / source 8a1ae764; page reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The report provides a locally generatable R2018 DXF ACIS-cube case and reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss through the named LibreDWG build, despite retaining REGION records.
sources.limits: The reproduction is issue-author evidence and was not rerun here; it is a failure-shape lead and demonstrates why entity presence is not payload or semantic evidence.

sources.revision: Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §24; local spec review already recorded in the implementation receipt
sources.observed: DataStorage parsing and association expectations remain grounded in the specification's segment/index/record/page structure rather than peer behavior.
sources.limits: This route research does not revise the normative wire contract or qualify any parser.

decision.planDelta: Bind FreeCAD qualification to one exact converter-plus-importer route per platform, score only the selected backend's documented entities, mark stock ACIS/AcDs import expected unsupported, do not mistake exporter flattening for 3D import, and preserve LibreCAD_3 as an experimental read/2D/API compatibility consumer rather than an independent semantic or DWG-write witness.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin the FreeCAD build, operating system/architecture, converter executable/version/arguments/exit status, output DXF hash/version, selected importer backend/add-on/settings, and per-object dispositions.
Test 3DFACE only when the legacy Python importer is selected and its add-on revision is bound; do not expect it from the documented C++ importer.
Classify stock FreeCAD ACIS/AcDs solids as OUT_OF_PROFILE / EXPECTED_UNSUPPORTED and do not require this unsupported route to pass the Linux/Windows consumer gate.

At the existing composed checkpoint, keep converter carriage, importer object construction, and ACIS/B-rep semantics as separate evidence dimensions; do not add routine peer executions or a Cartesian importer/converter matrix.
Preserve the LibreCAD_3 2D/API compatibility test while treating opt-in DWG import as experimental and read-only.
If an independent ACIS/AcDs semantic route cannot be bound to an exact profile, parser, and kernel, record NOT_QUALIFIED once and self-unblock without promoting any deferred J item.
